settings.heading: Thank you, we have got your details
settings.body:
From what you have told us we can work out the products, stock opportunities and support most likely to be useful to you.

Your next step is the free GBG Reseller Community. Inside it you can:
settings.note: Free to join. Leave whenever you like.

settings.text: Connect with other aspiring and existing resellers
Ask questions about starting and growing a product business
Learn how to choose products and avoid common beginner mistakes
Get selected stock opportunities and GBG updates
Learn from people who are already selling online
Find opportunities that suit your budget and business stage

settings.heading: Once you are inside the community

settings.text: Introduce yourself. Tell us where you are based and whether you are already selling or just getting started.
Watch the getting-started videos. They explain how the reseller business works and whether it suits you.
Keep an eye on stock opportunities. Products, wholesale opportunities and reseller offers get shared regularly.
Ask questions. If you are unsure about products, platforms, pricing or getting started, that is what the group is for.

settings.body: Helping aspiring and existing resellers find products, learn how to sell and build sustainable product businesses.
